questionsToConsider: Which kinds of information can you share, and which should the form say you can't?
Do personal record requests need an identity check in your setting, and what counts as proof?
Are you bound by a response deadline for some requests, and should the ending mention it?
Which delivery methods can your team really offer?
guide.howToUseResponses: Log each request with the date it arrived, because many information requests carry a response deadline set by law or policy. Check the identity proof before releasing any personal records, and delete uploaded ID once it has been checked if you don't need to keep it. Group requests by topic every few months: questions that keep coming back are usually a sign the answer should be published on your website.
customizeSteps: Edit the topic list to the kinds of information people actually ask your organisation for.
Change the identity check wording to match what your organisation accepts as proof.
Link the form from your contact, privacy or help page so requests arrive in one place.

faqs.q: What is an information request form?
faqs.a: A form someone uses to ask an organisation for documents, records or details. It records who asked, what they need and how to send it, so nothing gets lost in an inbox.

faqs.q: Should I verify identity before sharing information?
faqs.a: Yes, whenever the information is about a specific person. This form only asks for proof of identity when someone requests their own records.

faqs.q: Can I use this for subject access or freedom of information requests?
faqs.a: It can be a starting point, but those requests follow specific legal rules where you are. Check what your law requires and edit the questions and ending to match.

faqs.q: Can I change how people receive the information?
faqs.a: Yes. Copy it with Use this template and edit the delivery options; each one can lead to its own follow-up question.

doc.title: Information request
doc.description: Take requests for documents or details, and know where and how to send the reply.

blocks.title: Looking for some information from us? Tell us what you need and we'll get it to you.

options.label: Records about me or my account

blocks.title: Do you have an account, customer or case number?
blocks.description: It helps us find your records quickly. Leave blank if you don't know it.

blocks.title: Please upload proof of identity
blocks.description: We only release personal records to the person they belong to. A photo of an ID document is enough.

blocks.title: What exactly would you like to receive?
blocks.description: Name the document, time period or topic if you can.

blocks.title: What do you need it for?
blocks.description: Optional, but it helps us send the most useful version.
